title: cpa1920: Communist Party of America book code of 1920-21, grid rebuilt from the Bureau's own decodes, catalogue 678 (contributed by WAINUT)
bernstorff1917: Bernstorff's code telegram of 10 Jan 1917 (catalogue 657), first 147 groups aligned with his telegram No. 205, read in part (contributed by WAINUT)
morris1813: Anthony Morris's code (catalogue 650) is the State Department code of targets/jqa with its blocks of 100 in reverse order; frame 0039 read in part (contributed by WAINUT)
eckert1862: ledger mssEC 19 pp. 1-7 (catalogue 648) decoded with Cipher Book No. 9 (mssEC 67), 11 of 14 telegrams read, 9 printed in the Official Records (contributed by WAINUT)
taylor1865: Civil War telegrams 1865, Richard Taylor's Confederate letter-books read with COME RETRIBUTION (catalogue 681) (contributed by WAINUT)
astrea1799: Rozier's cipher letters to Talleyrand, 1798, catalogue 628: pointer to Pickering's 1799 check, no text online (contributed by WAINUT)
revenga1822: catalogue 641, Revenga's intercepted letter from Madrid (1822), key recovered, read in part (contributed by WAINUT)
visser1917 (catalogue 698): Kolbeck/Visser symbol message and key strip located in BI case OG 2889, not deciphered (contributed by WAINUT)
dana1783, appleton1823, everett1825, crawford1813, ellis1839: Dana's 1783 cipher recovered (key WIN); four letters of 1813-1839 in the JQA code, one folder each (contributed by WAINUT)
maisse1593, rennes1563: Henri IV to Maisse 1593 read in part from the Brienne clear copies (catalogue 17); Catherine de Médicis f. 55 third pass (catalogue 11) (contributed by WAINUT)
carlos1903, manuel1910, sabugosa1910, lima1909, hintze1903: Portuguese royal code telegrams 1903-1910, catalogue 401, 406, 408, 409, 410 (contributed by WAINUT)
mecklenburg1734: Erffa's P.S. 13, Vienna 18 Dec 1734 (Hann. 9g Nr. 964 ff. 8r-8v), contemporary decipherment transcribed and read in part (catalogue 598)
lovell1781: Continental Congress motion of 10 Aug 1781 deciphered with Lovell's Jay key, and an inventory of the cipher pieces in PCC item 59 vol. 1 (catalogue 631; contributed by WAINUT)
